description: This file is a Makefile fragment for configuring version-related variables in the OpenWrt build system. It defines version information, URLs, and dependencies specific to the OpenWrt project, including functions for sanitizing and escaping strings for use in scripts.

methods.name: taint2sym
methods.description: Converts a taint string to its symbolic configuration name.

methods.name: taint2name
methods.description: Extracts the name part from a taint string.

methods.name: sed_escape
methods.description: Escapes special characters for use in sed scripts.
